tests.title: Requirement, test, waiver and evidence policy meta-validation
tests.environment: Pinned Node LTS; clean planner package checkout
tests.oracle: Exit 0 only when schemas, unique IDs, bidirectional traceability, non-waivable policy, waiver expiry and evidence provenance checks pass.

tests.title: Architecture boundary and prohibited-coupling scan
tests.environment: Clean source checkout; generated dependency graph; no network
tests.oracle: Exit 0 when package/dependency/source rules show independent products, platform/domain separation, React/TS runtime, declared scope, no direct DB/browser path, and no copied reference code.

tests.title: Package pinning, compatibility and provenance matrix
tests.environment: Isolated registry proxy; signed package fixtures
tests.oracle: All products use exact compatible versions; every released supported schema major installs and runs (current only before a second major exists; current and N-1 thereafter); unsigned, floating or incompatible packages are rejected.

tests.title: Docker Compose topology and clean startup
tests.environment: Clean Linux host with Docker/Compose; no pre-existing volumes
tests.oracle: PostgreSQL and Redis are present, durable/ephemeral responsibilities match policy, images are pinned, health checks pass and a clean environment reaches ready state reproducibly.

tests.title: Design token, catalog and theme contract
tests.environment: Pinned Node/browser; protected component fixtures
tests.oracle: No forbidden style values; registrations are complete/stable; product extensions use the contract; only allowed theme overrides apply and contrast remains valid.

tests.title: WCAG 2.2 AA, keyboard and focus conformance
tests.environment: Pinned browser/fonts; desktop viewports; axe plus protected keyboard journeys
tests.oracle: Zero serious/critical automated violations; all keyboard/focus/zoom/reduced-motion/contrast assertions pass for registered states and theme variants.

tests.title: Locale, translation and timezone matrix
tests.environment: Frozen clock; protected message catalogs and expected values
tests.oracle: No missing/raw keys; switching is deterministic; dates/numbers/currencies/timezones match protected expected output without changing stored UTC values.

tests.title: Protected desktop visual regression and usable-time assertions
tests.environment: Pinned browser/OS/fonts/color profile; protected goldens
tests.oracle: Per-page pixel/layout thresholds pass in light/dark and tenant themes, semantic elements are present, and the performance run meets the declared usable-time threshold.

tests.title: Specification schema, catalog escape and complexity fuzzing
tests.environment: No network; fixed seeds plus generated property cases
tests.oracle: Valid specs round-trip; unknown/unauthorized IDs, prototype pollution, code/HTML/CSS/SQL/URL payloads and size/depth/cost overflows are rejected atomically without execution or partial render.

tests.title: Specification N/N-1 migration and rollback
tests.environment: Protected corpus for each released supported schema version
tests.oracle: With one released major: the compatibility matrix truthfully declares current 1, previous null and migration/rollback not-applicable; unknown, future, fractional or unavailable versions fail closed; no synthetic major or corpus is fabricated. With two or more released majors: migrations are deterministic/idempotent; supported specs preserve semantics; forward/rollback round-trip meets normalized equality and the compatibility matrix is complete.

tests.title: Revision, authorization, publish and rollback state machine
tests.environment: Real PostgreSQL; fixed principals/roles; browser and API clients
tests.oracle: History is immutable; invalid drafts never activate; scope/role/recent-auth rules hold; rollback creates a new auditable publication; removed capabilities fail saved queries closed.

tests.title: OAuth, invitation, account-linking and session abuse suite
tests.environment: Better Auth reference service; deterministic OIDC provider simulators; browser
tests.oracle: OAuth-only login works; self-signup/password is absent; forged issuer/subject/email/domain/tenant/invite/link/session/CSRF/fixation/replay cases are denied and revocation is immediate.

tests.title: Role, permission and cross-tenant authorization property matrix
tests.environment: Real control and tenant PostgreSQL databases; synthetic principals/capabilities
tests.oracle: All allowed outcomes match policy and unauthorized read/write/publish/query/manifest expansion attempts equal zero; backend and control-plane decisions agree; the run includes a re-execution of the AUTHZ-001 interface-level property matrix against the real full stack, with identical results.

tests.title: Interface-level authorization property matrix (fixture principals)
tests.environment: Reference spec store; fixture principals/tenants; synthetic capabilities; no external identity provider
tests.oracle: All allowed outcomes match policy and unauthorized read/write/publish/query/manifest expansion attempts equal zero at the control-plane/capability interface, over the fixture principal and tenant set.

tests.title: Recent-auth and privileged-operation challenge suite
tests.environment: OIDC simulators with time/MFA claims; frozen/advanced clock
tests.oracle: Freshness windows and tenant MFA policy match the risk matrix; stale/replayed challenges fail; successful challenges bind to user/session/operation.

tests.title: Tenant database isolation and poisoned-pool property suite
tests.environment: Real PostgreSQL/PgBouncer; control DB plus tenant DBs; SQL audit enabled
tests.oracle: Zero cross-tenant rows/connections; client tenant overrides fail; roles cannot connect/read other databases; poisoned session/search-path/prepared-statement state cannot bleed; internal row scope holds.

tests.title: Tenant provisioning, migration, placement and deletion lifecycle
tests.environment: Multiple PostgreSQL cluster fixtures; secret-provider simulator; backup fixture
tests.oracle: Provision/migration is idempotent/resumable/canaried; credentials stay opaque; placement caps hold; deletion disables immediately and eventually removes tenant assets without affecting neighbors.

tests.title: Language-neutral capability protocol conformance
tests.environment: TLS test mesh; deterministic JWKS and adapters
tests.oracle: All adapters negotiate versions and validate manifests/principals/errors identically; malformed/unsigned/expired/wrong-audience responses fail closed; no browser/database shortcut exists.

tests.title: Restricted query AST, relationship and cost property suite
tests.environment: Reference adapters and real PostgreSQL; query audit; deterministic seeds
tests.oracle: Authorized ASTs return expected results; raw SQL/unknown identifiers/inferred joins/unauthorized fields or rows/over-cost cases are rejected before execution; cursors, cancellation and saved-query invalidation hold.

tests.title: Export authorization, limits, lifecycle and injection suite
tests.command: platform-conformance run exports --formats csv,xlsx --fixture northstar --malicious-cells protected
tests.environment: Real object storage fixture; frozen clock; spreadsheet parser
tests.oracle: Only authorized filtered rows/fields export; limits and concurrency hold; formula cells are inert; auth/download expiry/replay/tenant binding/deletion/audit all pass.

tests.title: Action manifest and execution-gate contract
tests.environment: Reference manifests; no domain action handler
tests.oracle: All declared action metadata validates; arbitrary code/SQL/network/infrastructure scopes fail; execute endpoint remains unavailable until upstream gate evidence is valid.

tests.title: Action preview, idempotency, concurrency, reauth and audit suite
tests.environment: Real PostgreSQL; action handler fixture; frozen/advanced clock
tests.oracle: Preview binding and risk auth hold; retries/races commit one allowed effect; stale versions fail; only declared application records change; durable jobs/audit reflect every outcome.

tests.title: Threat-model coverage and web security abuse suite
tests.environment: Deployed reference stack; browser/DAST clients; malicious project responses
tests.oracle: Threat-control-test mapping is complete and applicable CSRF/CORS/CSP/XSS/SSRF/redirect/upload/input/error/request-limit abuse cases do not achieve the forbidden outcome.

tests.title: Encryption, secret rotation and secret-exposure suite
tests.environment: TLS test mesh; secret-provider simulator; CI/agent fixture
tests.oracle: Plaintext/downgrade connections fail; least-privilege rotation/revocation succeeds; secret canaries never appear in Git, agent/model payloads, logs, traces, exports, images or evidence.

tests.title: Layered rate-limit and Redis failure behavior
tests.environment: Reference stack; distributed clients; Redis fault injection
tests.oracle: Thresholds hold per dimension; privileged endpoints do not fail open; normal reads use bounded documented fallback; no tenant can consume another tenant's quota.

tests.title: Audit completeness, retention and telemetry redaction
tests.environment: Real PostgreSQL and self-hosted telemetry fixture; frozen/advanced clock
tests.oracle: All mandatory events and outcomes appear with required IDs; canary secrets/raw data do not; retention boundaries delete exactly on policy; external export is absent by default.

tests.title: Container and software supply-chain release suite
tests.environment: Clean builders; registry proxy; malicious dependency fixtures
tests.oracle: Containers satisfy runtime policy; builds are reproducible; secrets/high findings/unknown licenses fail; SBOM/notices complete; source/package/image signatures and provenance verify.

tests.title: Tailscale management-plane exposure and ACL suite
tests.environment: Reference Hetzner/Tailscale staging profile; outside and tailnet probes
tests.oracle: Public scans cannot reach management services; unapproved tailnet identities/roles are denied; approved operations require service auth and are audited.

tests.title: Residency policy and deployed-resource inventory
tests.environment: Provisioned staging profile; IaC/cloud/object/telemetry/model destination inventory; network capture
tests.oracle: Primary databases, replicas, backups, exports, audit, telemetry and model processing destinations are explicitly declared and contained in the product residency allowlist; undeclared region/egress fixtures fail.

tests.title: Certified multi-tenant load and fairness benchmark
tests.environment: Versioned hardware/topology/browser/workload; synthetic datasets; warm and cold phases
tests.oracle: p95 reads <=150ms, writes <=300ms, dashboard usable <=1.5s, errors <=0.1%, all spec/query caps hold and noisy tenants do not violate fairness/isolation thresholds.

tests.title: Application component and host failure drill
tests.environment: Multi-host staging behind Hetzner load balancer; immutable candidate images
tests.oracle: Healthy replicas continue, client-observed recovery is <=5m, no duplicate/corrupt operations occur, and outcome does not depend solely on Coolify state.

tests.title: PostgreSQL primary failure RPO/RTO drill
tests.environment: Patroni HA staging; independent client write ledger and WAL positions
tests.oracle: A safe replica promotes and clients recover <=5m; every acknowledged ledger write exists exactly once; no split brain or unsafe async promotion occurs.

tests.title: Backup restore, tenant deletion and complete-location DR drill
tests.environment: Isolated recovery location/account; production-shaped synthetic data; no source hosts
tests.oracle: Database-aware backups/WAL alone restore control and tenant data/roles/specs/audit; deletion/retention expectations hold; measured provisional RPO <=5m and RTO <=4h or the gate explicitly fails for target revision.

tests.title: Redis failover and total-loss degradation drill
tests.environment: Redis primary/replica/Sentinel staging; active authenticated workload
tests.oracle: Failover/recovery behavior matches profile; total loss does not lose durable jobs/specs/audit/session authority or bypass auth/rate limits; cache rebuild does not cross tenants.

tests.title: Self-hosted observability, opt-in and alert coverage
tests.environment: Self-hosted telemetry stack; blocked external collector; synthetic faults
tests.oracle: No external destination receives traffic by default; required metrics/alerts fire within declared windows; payload scans contain no prohibited data.

tests.title: AI authoring safety and adversarial corpus
tests.environment: Provider adapters or deterministic recorded responses; no customer data; tool/network trap endpoints
tests.oracle: G4 prerequisite is valid; every candidate is draft-only and validated; unauthorized/executable/raw-SQL/network/tool publication equals zero; request capture contains no live records; explicit publish policy holds.

tests.title: Provider adapter and production credential boundary
tests.environment: Trusted staging with provider-supported service credentials; headless user-session traps
tests.oracle: Normalized behavior works for both providers; production endpoint refuses headless/user-session credentials; quota, timeout, retry, redaction and disabled-external-observability policies match.

tests.title: Screenshot-to-spec structural, functional and visual evaluation
tests.environment: Pinned prompts/models/settings where supported; protected screenshots and semantic assertions
tests.oracle: Every publishable result passes deterministic safety; aggregate structural/functional/visual thresholds and confidence intervals meet the protected G5 rubric for both adapters.

tests.title: Claude Code and Codex adapter conformance
tests.environment: Developer and private-runner profiles; synthetic repository; secret canaries
tests.oracle: Both adapters accept the common envelope, return schema-valid normalized results, respect time/path/tool budgets, do not expose public execution or credential canaries, and classify blocks consistently.

tests.title: Checkpoint and resume drill
tests.environment: PostgreSQL checkpointer; frozen/advanced clock
tests.oracle: Every failure resumes from a valid checkpoint; human approval interrupts persist across a 24h-simulated pause without duplicate side effects.

tests.title: Fan-out and fan-in drill
tests.environment: PostgreSQL checkpointer/queue
tests.oracle: Fan-in from bounded parallel builder/verifier nodes is complete and conflict-aware, and detects conflicting edits or missing results.

tests.title: Queue recovery drill
tests.environment: PostgreSQL queue; Redis
tests.oracle: Redis loss is harmless; scheduled task and approval state recovers from PostgreSQL without duplication or loss of pending work.

tests.title: Idempotent external effects drill
tests.environment: PostgreSQL checkpointer/queue; fake GitHub side effects
tests.oracle: Exactly one branch/PR side effect exists for each stable operation ID after kill-every-node retries and replay.

tests.title: Agent authority, protected-path, egress and evidence-forgery suite
tests.environment: Synthetic repositories/rules; egress proxy; fake production/secrets; evidence signer
tests.oracle: Merge/deploy/protected edits/waiver/signing/production secret/network escape attempts are denied and audited; fabricated or mismatched evidence fails; allowed branch/PR succeeds.

tests.title: Graphify commit binding and source-verification policy
tests.environment: Synthetic repository revisions and Graphify code-only indexes; no network
tests.oracle: Current index may aid context; stale/mismatched index is ignored; inferred-only claim cannot pass planning/evidence; source and registry verification is recorded.

tests.title: Northstar declarative frontend functional/structural suite
tests.environment: Clean product repo, mock capability backend, reference spec store, fixture principals, pinned browser
tests.oracle: All required routes/structures/states/locales/themes/workflows/role outcomes pass through runtime; source scan finds no route-specific React page or copied reference dependency. The full-stack variant of this suite re-runs against real control/tenant databases at Track B (G4A).

tests.title: Schema importer and contract linter conformance
tests.environment: Reference GraphQL and OpenAPI fixture schemas; known-good and known-thin manifest fixtures; no live backend
tests.oracle: Importer output from the reference GraphQL and OpenAPI fixtures validates against the capability-manifest schema as unpublished drafts requiring human approval; `structile check` emits deterministic structural-completeness findings against known-good and known-thin fixture manifests and never asserts authorization correctness.

tests.title: Quickstart time-to-first-render and playground smoke
tests.environment: Versioned hardware/network profile; clean machine image; compose-up entrypoint
tests.oracle: Scripted clean-machine quickstart reaches first rendered dashboard output within 5 minutes wall-clock from compose-up on the fixed hardware profile; the hosted playground smoke journey completes without error; both published worked examples (one GraphQL, one OpenAPI capability fixture) build and render through the importer plus renderer path.

tests.title: Support tooling determinism suite
tests.environment: Reference spec store; fixture principals; deterministic canonical shared views
tests.oracle: Spec diff against the canonical shared view is deterministic and byte-stable across reruns; explain-this-view answers derive only from the specification and principal with no other input; admin view-as and reset round-trip without residual state.

tests.title: Open-source boundary, Apache-2.0 and notice compliance
tests.environment: Clean public release tree and built packages/images
tests.oracle: Original core carries Apache-2.0; MIT and other approved notices are retained; public artifacts contain all required core surfaces and no secrets/customer/proprietary domain logic; SBOM matches distributions.

tests.title: Delivery guardrail enforcement
tests.environment: Clean candidate checkout with task contracts and CI configuration; no network
tests.oracle: Oversized, out-of-scope, contract-modifying or contract-less implementation PRs are rejected by CI; task-ready exists, validates every contract field and fails closed on violations; mechanical PRs reproduce byte-for-byte; a green task-ready is never emitted as release evidence.

tests.title: Runner subset and unsigned-envelope authority rejection
tests.environment: Pinned runner image; the suite internally exercises subset runs with builder-equivalent credentials and no signing identity
tests.oracle: The suite's own envelope is signed and authoritative. Internally it invokes named-subset unsigned runs and asserts: the subset executes exactly the requested tests; every internally emitted envelope carries localUnsigned true; and the evidence gate rejects localUnsigned or malformed envelopes as authority for any requirement or gate claim.
